//: Typecheck config for the notifications tree (ags-apps/notifications).
WHY THIS GATE EXISTS: `ags bundle` TRANSPILES WITHOUT TYPE CHECKING, so a
type error is an app that builds and fails at runtime. Same posture as the
`ags types -u` writes its OWN `tsconfig.json` into whichever directory it
runs against and OVERWRITES it on every run, so this file deliberately
uses a non-colliding name. Do not rename it to tsconfig.json.
this tree's OWN @girs/ + env.d.ts: the GIR modules describe THIS machine,
not the consuming tree. The Makefile gate declares that dependency
The `ags`/`ags/*` paths map (identical to tsconfig.bar.json / pano) makes
`ags` resolve for EVERY file in the program, including the external
platform's adapters (which import `ags/gtk4/app`), instead of depending on
where a per-directory symlink happens to sit. `resolveJsonModule` is
required because the platform's adapters/icon-registry.ts imports its own
icons.json. `skipLibCheck` skips the generated @girs/ identifier clashes.
`lib` needs ES2022+DOM for the gnim JSX runtime.
